rules: Use generated fixtures, public-domain media, explicit Creative Commons media, or media intentionally published for testing.
Do not use cookies, browser profiles, authenticated media, DRM, commercial music, or random creator uploads.
External properties are observations unless the manifest marks them as stable assertions.
Never use an exact media hash as a cross-run assertion unless the source publisher provides an immutable artifact.
